items.q: And she‘s a good friend. She‘s a funny lady.

ctx.x: Yes. And she‘s a good friend. She‘s a funny lady. Yeah.

I asked you about this before, but just to clarify, with Perception Records—we did talk a little bit about this; maybe I shouldn‘t go back to it—I was just going to ask you again about the difference between recording for a larger label like Mercury Records, or in later years even Steeplechase was a very prestigious jazz label, a largely jazz label, and certainly Verve.
